title: Adedeji Adeleke
content:
Adedeji Tajudeen Adeleke (born 6 March 1957) is a Nigerian business magnate and president of Adeleke University. He is also the CEO of Pacific Holdings Limited.  He is the father of Davido, a Nigerian musician and Sharon Adeleke. He was married to Dr Vero Adeleke who died on 6 March 2003. His younger brother Ademola Adeleke is the current serving governor of Osun State.


== Education ==
In 1979, Adeleke obtained a Bachelor's of Science degree in Finance from Western Kentucky University.
